notes.title: V.0.8.12a Russian language and counterattack
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27379511/9e65371fb77f241ceb95d7bc9474de80ff739886.gif[/img]

Hello everyone,

Happy to say that the [b]Russian language[/b] has been added by help of one passionate Russian gamer. He can even beat our game without death. It’s amazing. Now, thanks to his effort, more Russian gamers can enjoy the game. We hope to add more localizations in the future.

We’ve always desired feedback. Fortunately, received a lot feedback after publishing the demo. Among the feedback, we lowered the counterattack difficulty first in this patch. Please understand this change is experimental and not permanent.

This update doesn’t apply other feedback yet. For now, we’re trying and spending time to spread our game before ending the weeklong sale. After the sale, we’ll be back with a new update.

Thank you!

[h1]CHANGES[/h1]
[list][*]Added Russian language. Select it on in-game option menu.
[*]Increased the counterattack window.
[*]Fixed some minor issues.[/list]

[h1]KNOWN ISSUE[/h1]
[list][*]Some tutorial messages can be displayed in different language after changing language during the tutorial.[/list]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27379511/81657a73b4a4cae5bf4bc37ca5a3fa70deb1d279.png[/img][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27379511/26a18d3751166bf667f40d7aa432d0acc104a07e.png[/img]

notes.title: Demo available now! A round-up of updates in the last three months.
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27379511/bd3ecaf9093323622ee6f8d0a7fb436230338df1.png[/img]
Three months have already passed since Early Access Launch and a lot has happened.
After lots of thought, we made and released a [b]public demo[/b] for [i]Gone with the Demon[/i]. In this demo, you can access to two early levels and face the gargantuan Demon boss.
Give it a shot! And when you have anything you would like to tell us, please let us know. If you want more levels, weapons, enemies and bosses, this week is a good chance to get the full version and support us. Because we’re offering a [b][i]40%[/i] discount this week.[/b]

Also, it led us to want to put all of the major changes in one place to make it easy to see.
Here’s a list of them:[list][*]Tutorial.
[*]New Demon, Doorkeeper.
[*]Destructible crates.
[*]More responsive and rewarding combat system.
[*]Informative input guide on HUD and tips.
[*]Trap pits.
[*]Improved attack animations and weapon abilities.
[*]Patched in a number of bug fixes and minor improvements.[/list]

Lastly, there’s a good news for the Russian gamers. One passionate Russian Youtuber/streamer offered to translate the game into Russian. We’re working on it with him. [b]Russian language[/b] will be added soon!

Many thanks to everyone who’s played the game, given feedback and supported us!

notes.title: V.0.7.10a is Live! & Dev Blog #5
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27379511/a430b63d6fcc057a87f200e7bca30137f78c9999.gif[/img]
[i](Dance faster!)[/i]

Hello everyone,

Before we improve AI and add a storyline, we focused on the combat speed and responsive controls last week. The combat in this game is relatively slow and heavy as a result of emphasizing player's plans and decisions. Although these things are features of the game, there were feedback regarding the slow attacks and controls. We’ve considered these issues and decided to improve them.

The first is attack speed. The meat tenderizer was especially difficult to use and it now attacks faster. Some normal speed weapons became a little faster. The weapons that should be slow are still slow. The weapons now have more personalities.

Regarding the responsive controls, there was something we missed. Your feedbacks let us know. 

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27379511/ebf67b32d50931bd8907617260d16385bacc9bbd.jpg[/img]

Assuming the player is doing ACTION 1. If you input to do ACTION 2 in “Receive input”, ACTION 1 goes smoothly to ACTION 2 . If there’s no input in “Receive input”, ACTION 1 goes to a neutral state. The problem is, if you input to do ACTION 2 in “Transition”, it is not executed before “Transition” ends. This means that if you input to do something a little later, the actual execution is much more delayed.

That was the problem and we changed it. The game now responds to the input in the “Transition” except attacks, and the controls are more responsive. The reason why attacks 
are excluded is that the game has the combo system. We don’t want button-mashing to have the effect similar to the combo.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27379511/a6f313bfda9b3bd306f401606dba2376f4583ab9.gif[/img]
[i](The kick couldn’t have made him stumble.)[/i]

When you kicked the enemy who was guarding, sometimes the enemy released guarding right before getting kicked, and attacked you. This feels quite unfair because the kicking motion is long and not cancelable. In this case, we decided to reward the player for making the right choice. So when you kick, if the enemy is guarding, it will make the enemy stumble unconditionally even if you cannot break the guard. Also, we changed the kicking motion so that it is much quicker, more wild, and easier to understand that the motion is progressing.

One of our devs has desired to show fun gameplay all the time. So she eventually recorded her gameplay. The following is the video edited at 1.5x speed.

https://youtu.be/HzujemU5n8U

Your words always give us direction and inspiration. We hope you like the update.

[h1]IMPROVEMENTS - COMBAT[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed the attack speed of some weapons.
[*] In the closing transition of movements, input except attacks is now more responsive.
[*] When the player starts kicking, if the enemies are guarding, the kick made them staggered without fail even though they release guarding.
[*] Changed the kicking animation.
[*] To avoid unintended Stamina consumption, all actions (except dodging) close the running state.
[*] Made the counterattack easier when changing the guard’s direction.
[/list]

[h1]IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changed the order of weapon stats.
[*] Decreased the amount of Essence the bosses give.
[*] Added the guard-breaking sound.
[*] Added the sound of the spider getting hit.
[/list]

[h1]FIX[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug with the player’s lower body animation while using items.
[*] Fixed a glitch with the attacking enemy’s face shown through the frying pan when guarding.
[*] Fixed a bug that displays the level of morale in the tutorial.
[*] Fixed a bug with the spider moving through the Doorkeeper.
[*] Fixed a bug that backstabs an enemy behind the player.
[*] Fixed a bug that locks on some spiders through walls or doors.
[*] Fixed an issue with traps sometimes making sounds for unknown reason.
[/list]

notes.title: V.0.7.6a is Live!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

A new update is available now. This update includes all the new content we shared with you on the last Dev Blog. Also, we finally fixed the loading crash. Please let us know if this update cannot solve the crash issue. We also fixed some annoying bugs related to the game controller, and there were some sound, image, effects, and balance improvements. For more information, please check the Changelog below!

[b]※ Not compatible with older save files.[/b]

[h1]NEW CONTENT[/h1]
[list]
[*] The combo list of the weapon is now displayed in the inventory.
[*] Added destructible crates.
[*] Counterattacking with the meat tenderizer now knocks out some enemies.
[*] Backstabbing with the frying pan now knocks out some enemies.
[*] The red bandana masked guy now has a new attack pattern with two kitchen knives. 
[*] Added some hints on the death screen.
[/list]

[h1]IMPROVEMENTS[/h1]
[list]
[*] Enemies now respond to the projectiles.
[*] When a player is hit during dodge, the hit animation is now ignored.
[*] Added some sounds when enemies are knocked out or fall on the floor.
[*] Included minor balance changes.
[*] Improved hitting effects.
[*] The vendor on the second underground level does not sell a frying pan anymore.
[*] The image of the Xbox controller and mouse buttons has been changed to look better.
[/list]

[h1]FIX[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a loading crash that is supposed to be related to the Windows Media Player. 
[*] Fixed a bug occasionally causing the active input device to change constantly when the game controller is connected.
[/list]

[list]
[*] Some destructible objects are blinking or blackened after they are fractured. This will be fixed later.
[/list]

notes.title: Dev Blog #3: Break a Crate!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27379511/3a57c11c543d6eaa8d015ee23a9c2f624aa25daa.gif[/img]

Hello everyone!

We recharged our batteries for a week. And we’re making contents to make the game more interesting.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27379511/b563b19cadd6aad704d4b892cf737d22ae9cd516.jpg[/img]

The first is destructible crates. Crates will be destroyed by attacking, dodging, stones, Molotov cocktails and flying bodies of knocked-out enemies. We hope these various interactions will make the game richer. You may find hidden places or items behind the crates, but breaking crates is fun in itself!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27379511/99103d8524aaf4d4b56608049bd944452c453536.gif[/img]

The abilities to knockout are added to counterattacks and backstabs of some weapons. These have been added as part of the process of strengthening the weapon's personality, and these weapons have become more powerful.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27379511/73109d740f20a1d70d932243b7be08ad20d5a7f5.jpg[/img]

When you equip a weapon, the combo list of the weapon will be shown in the inventory. We have some ideas to make the process of acquiring a combo list more interesting, but they have been discarded because we thought they’re less significant.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27379511/d9f0cebce9fa38f1aeaddef2da1dcce3230765cd.gif[/img]

The red bandana masked guy will have a new attack pattern. This new attack is hard to dodge and know which direction he will attack, so the player is forced to guard. Like in the case of the Doorkeeper, we hope it helps players to get used to guarding.

Thanks to everyone for choosing and supporting our game!

notes.title: Dev Blog #2: Tutorial and Creepy Doorkeeper
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27379511/57e05b9c4874cc45f625ffac8eb41a9847e5a977.gif[/img]
Over the past two weeks, we've made a tutorial, Doorkeeper Demons, trap pits, some hints for hidden places and more. In particular, making the tutorial has taken up some time, but it’s in the final stage. We would like to add them as soon as possible, so we will update the game when the tutorial is ready for deployment.

When you start a new game, you will learn the basics of fighting from your instructor before you ride the elevator down to the underground. We are also preparing a short story that explains why you are going down to the underground, but it will be updated later. We hope this tutorial will help players get used to the game mechanics through hands-on experiences.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27379511/de3ab49a3d2fdf67d9bbd3fddf6fb4b8c30fc6fc.jpg[/img]
The new Demon, Doorkeeper is designed to look a bit creepy. It has enormous Life and only counterattack can do great damage to it. We intend players to use counterattacks against the doorkeepers and make use of it to other enemies naturally.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27379511/a28fc507430b8a5573312c74e66e779087f09f75.jpg[/img]
The trap pits were intended to give players some tension when moving.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27379511/d49a702484b8fe76244b92a5167cb29a211860c9.jpg[/img]
Some hidden places where we want players to discover as the game progresses are now more noticeable.

At this point we would like to share our rough plans for the next few months. Until April, we will focus on adding gameplay elements that will make the game more enjoyable, and we will intensively refine the game in May. More specific plans will be shared through following Dev Blogs.

Also, as you may already know, our game is built using Unreal Engine. Recently, a new version of Unreal Engine is released and it includes significant gains in overall stability. This is what we were looking forward to, so we plan to update our game engine once and for all around March.

Thank you!

notes.title: Dev Blog #1: Our first Steam game in Early Access
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27379511/d934678ce0e05c5a9e2b5b97720d0d7c249a1b70.jpg[/img]
[i][Tutorial Level Work In Progress][/i]

Nine days have already passed since Early Access Launch. We've worked in the video game scene for more than ten years and released several games. However, [i]Gone with the Demon[/i] is our first Steam game. The launch was a valuable experience. Also, it is just the beginning.

Many things happened, but the most important thing was player’s feedback and response. We had not received a lot of feedback before. We’re so thankful to receive various feedback through the launch.

Among the feedback, one major problem attracted our attention. Many players couldn’t know the game mechanics at all, and they couldn’t enjoy the game. We respect players' various play styles. However, we should let them know their options, and provide interesting opportunities to be skilled enough so that the game can be much more fun.

So, here are our plans!
[list]
[*] Tutorials for basic mechanics
[*] More informative input guide on HUD
[*] Accessible move set list of each weapon
[*] New enemies that require a specific mechanic
[*] More hints for gameplay elements, including hidden places
[*] Reinforce in-game guides
[/list]
Fortunately, there are some positive responses. We are really grateful to all the supporters for their feedback. We will make an effort to make the game good enough to enjoy.
Thank you.
